readBy: an MCP call's count class (read, change, send or destructive) and effect class (push, merge, dispatch, send or delete): a server is one of these only when the agent loads it under this name from a scope listed here with this config; any other server, and a tool not listed, counts as change. Read by deep-hook too (#1848): a tool's `paths` names the arguments that hold local paths, the only ones its path guards read; a tool with none listed has each whitespace-free string argument read as a path

github.readBy: GitHub's official remote server, as GitHub's install docs write it into Claude Code's user or local MCP config
